_about: PARKED DRAFT. 30 keepsakes: a small trophy of what happened in a won fight, shown in the haul and on the menu shelf. The trigger names an event the fight log already has or Game Design adds; none is a death (Legal c08). {place} is the fight's place name. Claude-written; not marked by Orb. Re-cut 2026-10-18: Jar of Ash is Sky Jar, Fused Sand Chip is Blast Sand Chip (Legal RL-158); four triggers swapped to events the sim has (Game Design 6b).

keepsakes.name: Tower Brick
keepsakes.line: Still warm. From the tower in the fight.

keepsakes.name: Bridge Bolt
keepsakes.line: One bolt from {place}'s bridge. Heavier than it looks.

keepsakes.name: Cracked Lens
keepsakes.line: The rival's lens. He'd like it back.

keepsakes.name: Bent Frame
keepsakes.line: Custom, he said. It still is.

keepsakes.name: Scorched Banner
keepsakes.line: A banner from {place}, singed at one corner.

keepsakes.name: Blast Sand Chip
keepsakes.line: A chip of sand the blast turned hard.

keepsakes.name: Clash Ribbon
keepsakes.line: Scorched ribbon from a beam struggle you won.

keepsakes.name: Singed Sleeve
keepsakes.line: A sleeve that lost the beam struggle.

keepsakes.name: Torn Knuckle Wrap
keepsakes.line: Torn on the first blow. Worth it.

keepsakes.name: Chalked Hand
keepsakes.line: Chalk, left on the ground where you got up.

keepsakes.name: Coil Spring
keepsakes.line: Wound tight, then let go. It still hums.

keepsakes.name: Salt Stone
keepsakes.line: A pebble that came out of the sea with you.

keepsakes.name: Hot Sand Jar
keepsakes.line: Sand from {place}. Warm even at night.

keepsakes.name: Slate Chip
keepsakes.line: A flat chip of slate from the ridge.

keepsakes.name: Split Branch
keepsakes.line: A branch that took a hit meant for you.

keepsakes.name: Frost Shard
keepsakes.line: A sliver of ice that never melts.

keepsakes.name: Whole Window
keepsakes.line: One window, still unbroken, in a battered street.

keepsakes.name: Thank-You Note
keepsakes.line: From someone you got out. No name, just thanks.

keepsakes.name: Splint Tape
keepsakes.line: Held your arm together for the finish.

keepsakes.name: Patched Glove
keepsakes.line: Stitched twice. It still fits.

keepsakes.name: Ranking Slip
keepsakes.line: His notes on you. You rank higher than he admits.

keepsakes.name: Dropped Cuff Link
keepsakes.line: A cuff link he left behind when he stepped in.

keepsakes.name: Too-Bright Token
keepsakes.line: Shinier than it should be. You kept it.

keepsakes.name: Plain Coin
keepsakes.line: You walked on. It's the only thing you kept.

keepsakes.name: Silk Scrap
keepsakes.line: A scrap of her silk. It cuts like paper.

keepsakes.name: Cold Limiter
keepsakes.line: His limiter chip, cracked and finally quiet.

keepsakes.name: Sky Jar
keepsakes.line: A jar of the dark sky, sealed before it settled.

keepsakes.name: Streetlamp Glass
keepsakes.line: A lens from a lamp that kept burning.

keepsakes.name: Worn Stopwatch
keepsakes.line: Stopped at the end of the longest fight.

keepsakes.name: Unused Bandage
keepsakes.line: You didn't need it. Keep it anyway.
